hooks.command: $json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $path = $json.tool_input.file_path; if ($path -and (Split-Path $path -Leaf) -eq 'paket.lock') { Write-Output (@{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse';permissionDecision='deny';permissionDecisionReason='paket.lock is generated by paket install/update - edit paket.dependencies and run paket install instead of hand-editing the lock file.'}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) }

$json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $path = $json.tool_input.file_path; if ($path) { $norm = $path -replace '\\','/'; if ($norm -match '(^|/)(src/Myriad\.Plugins|test/Myriad\.IntegrationPluginTests)/') { $out = dotnet build src/Myriad/Myriad.fsproj -c Debug 2>&1 | Out-String; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $out += (dotnet run --framework net9.0 --project ./test/Myriad.IntegrationPluginTests/Myriad.IntegrationPluginTests.fsproj 2>&1 | Out-String) }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output $out; exit 2 } } }
